261: 	for i, v := range logits {
262: 		probs[i] = math.Exp(float64(v) - maxLogit)
263: 		sum += probs[i]

376: func NewGPT(g *gorgonia.ExprGraph, config *GorgoniteConfig) *GPT {
377: 	embedding := NewEmbeddingLayer(g, config.VocabSize, config.EmbedDim, config.ContextLen)
378: 	posEncoding := NewPositionalEncoding(g, config.ContextLen, config.EmbedDim)
379: 
380: 	blocks := make([]*TransformerBlock, config.NumLayers)
381: 	for i := 0; i < config.NumLayers; i++ {
382: 		blocks[i] = NewTransformerBlock(g, config.EmbedDim, config.NumHeads, config.DropoutRate, config.ContextLen)
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	outputLayer := gorgonia.NewMatrix(g, tensor.Float32,
386: 		gorgonia.WithShape(config.EmbedDim, config.VocabSize),
387: 		gorgonia.WithName("output_projection"),
388: 		gorgonia.WithInit(gorgonia.GlorotN(1.0)),
389: 	)
390: 
391: 	// Collect learnable nodes (weights)
392: 	learnables := []*gorgonia.Node{embedding.embeddings, outputLayer}
393: 	// Attention and FFN weights from blocks
394: 	for _, block := range blocks {
395: 		learnables = append(learnables, block.attention.wOutput)
396: 		for _, head := range block.attention.heads {
397: 			learnables = append(learnables, head.wQuery, head.wKey, head.wValue)
398: 		}
399: 		learnables = append(learnables, block.feedForward.w1, block.feedForward.w2)
400: 	}
401: 
402: 	gpt := &GPT{
403: 		graph:       g,
404: 		config:      config,
405: 		embedding:   embedding,
406: 		posEncoding: posEncoding,
407: 		blocks:      blocks,
408: 		outputLayer: outputLayer,
409: 		learnables:  learnables,
410: 	}
411: 
412: 	// Build the graph
413: 	seqLen := config.ContextLen
414: 	x, err := embedding.Forward(seqLen)
415: 	if err != nil {
416: 		panic(err)
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	posEnc, err := posEncoding.Forward(seqLen)
420: 	if err != nil {
421: 		panic(err)
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	x, err = gorgonia.Add(x, posEnc)
425: 	if err != nil {
426: 		panic(err)
427: 	}
428: 
429: 	mask := createCausalMask(g, seqLen)
430: 
431: 	for _, block := range blocks {
432: 		x, err = block.Forward(x, mask, false)
433: 		if err != nil {
434: 			panic(err)
435: 		}
436: 	}
437: 
438: 	logits, err := gorgonia.Mul(x, outputLayer)
439: 	if err != nil {
440: 		panic(err)
441: 	}
442: 
443: 	gpt.logits = logits
444: 
445: 	loss, err := gorgonia.Mean(logits)
446: 	if err != nil {
447: 		panic(err)
448: 	}
449: 	gpt.loss = loss
450: 
451: 	fmt.Printf("Graph has %d nodes\n", len(g.AllNodes()))
452: 
453: 	return gpt
454: }

469: 		tensor.WithBacking(maskData),
470: 		tensor.WithShape(seqLen, seqLen),
471: 	)

708: func SampleToken(logits []float32, temperature float32, topK int) int {
709: 	if temperature != 1.0 {
710: 		for i := range logits {
711: 			logits[i] /= temperature
712: 		}
713: 	}
714: 
715: 	maxLogit := logits[0]
716: 	for _, l := range logits {
717: 		if l > maxLogit {
718: 			maxLogit = l
719: 		}
720: 	}
721: 
722: 	expSum := float32(0)
723: 	probs := make([]float32, len(logits))
724: 	for i, l := range logits {
725: 		probs[i] = float32(math.Exp(float64(l - maxLogit)))
726: 		expSum += probs[i]
727: 	}
728: 
729: 	for i := range probs {
730: 		probs[i] /= expSum
731: 	}
732: 
733: 	if topK > 0 && topK < len(probs) {
734: 		type indexedProb struct {
735: 			idx  int
736: 			prob float32
737: 		}
738: 
739: 		indexed := make([]indexedProb, len(probs))
740: 		for i, p := range probs {
741: 			indexed[i] = indexedProb{i, p}
742: 		}
743: 
744: 		sort.Slice(indexed, func(i, j int) bool {
745: 			return indexed[i].prob > indexed[j].prob
746: 		})
747: 
748: 		for i := topK; i < len(indexed); i++ {
749: 			probs[indexed[i].idx] = 0
750: 		}
751: 
752: 		sum := float32(0)
753: 		for _, p := range probs {
754: 			sum += p
755: 		}
756: 		for i := range probs {
757: 			probs[i] /= sum
758: 		}
759: 	}
760:
